cases.question: Which dungeon item shows where the Triforce piece is, and how many pieces do I need to enter Level 9?
cases.answer:
Most relevant excerpts from the sources (no generated summary):
[1] [Dungeon items > Piece of Triforce Triforce] There are eight of these. One is present in each dungeon. All eight are required to gain access to Level 9.
[2] [Walkthrough] The entrance to this dungeon has been moved away from Spectacle Rock, to a very remote corner of Hyrule. Bomb the middle of the north wall of A-1 in Section 7. - From the entrance head up one room where you might encounter a man who will prevent you from entering if you have not collected all eight pieces of the Triforce. If you have them, you may proceed and enter to the room…
[3] [Boss] - The boss of the dungeon is a three headed Gleeok. Defeat it by attacking all of the attached heads until no more heads are connected to the body. - Collect the Heart Container and then enter the room above to collect the fifth piece of the Triforce.

cases.question: What do I need to show the old woman to buy the Water of Life, and what does the potion do?
cases.answer:
Most relevant excerpts from the sources (no generated summary):
[1] [B Button items > Letter] A key item, this is the proof that you need to show to the Old Woman so that she will sell you the Water of Life.
[2] [Resupply] Dungeon 5 is isolated, and as such, you may want to look at the supply points before heading to the dungeon. - An old woman selling Water of Life and a 2nd Potion is 4 screens west and 1 screen south of the Lost Hills.
[3] [B Button items > Water of Life] Completely refills Link's life bar. After the first use of a Red Potion or 2nd Potion, it turns into a Blue Potion. The blue potion can only fill up your life once. Drinking a Water of Life can also restore the sword sealing effect brought about by Bubbles.

cases.question: wat does the boomrang stun
cases.answer:
Most relevant excerpts from the sources (no generated summary):
[1] [B Button items > Boomerang] The boomerang stuns large enemies, kills small enemies like Keese and Gels, and can be used to retrieve items. The Wooden Boomerang can travel a distance of roughly half the screen while the Magical Boomerang has a longer range and can travel from one end of the screen to the other.
[2] [Treasures of the eight levels] - Boomerang & Bow - Magic Boomerang - Raft & extra Heart Container - Stepladder, extra Heart Container & Magical Sword - Flute & more Bombs - Magic Wand - Red Candle & more Bombs - Magic Book & Magic Key - Red Ring & Silver Arrows
[3] [Objectives] - Obtain the Wooden Boomerang. - Beat Aquamentus. - Obtain a Heart Container. - Obtain the first Triforce piece.

He starts with three Heart Containers and can reach a maximum of 16 by the end…
